title: Add LDC and Food Service task categories and fix build

requirements.text: Add two new task category options, "LDC" and "Food Service", to the category dropdown in the Add Task modal, without changing, removing, or renaming any existing category options.

quotes:
Add two new task categories to the Tasks module:

1. Add "LDC" as a new category option in the task category dropdown.

2. Add "Food Service" as a new category option in the task category dropdown.

3. Make sure these new categories appear in:
   - The "Add Task" modal category dropdown
   - The "Edit Task" modal category dropdown
   - Any category filter dropdowns on the Tasks page

4. Keep all existing categories exactly as they are - just add the two new ones.

Keep everything else unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria: In the Add Task modal (frontend/src/components/tasks/AddTaskModal.tsx), the category Select dropdown includes "LDC" and "Food Service" in addition to all existing options.
All existing category options remain present and unchanged in label and value.
Selecting "LDC" or "Food Service" allows a task to be submitted successfully.

requirements.text: Add two new task category options, "LDC" and "Food Service", to the category dropdown in the Edit Task modal, without changing, removing, or renaming any existing category options.

quotes:
Make sure these new categories appear in:
   - The "Edit Task" modal category dropdown

acceptanceCriteria: In the Edit Task modal (frontend/src/components/tasks/EditTaskModal.tsx), the category Select dropdown includes "LDC" and "Food Service" in addition to all existing options.
All existing category options remain present and unchanged in label and value.
A task whose category is set to "LDC" or "Food Service" can be saved successfully from the Edit Task modal.

requirements.text: Ensure any category filter dropdowns on the Tasks page include the new category options "LDC" and "Food Service" (if such dropdowns exist), while keeping all existing filter options unchanged.

quotes:
Make sure these new categories appear in:
   - Any category filter dropdowns on the Tasks page

acceptanceCriteria: If the Tasks page has any category filter dropdown UI, it includes both "LDC" and "Food Service" options.
No existing filter options are changed or removed.

requirements.text: Resolve the current build failure related to the Tasks category change and ensure the app builds successfully after adding the new categories.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend TypeScript build completes successfully after adding the new categories (no type errors from CategoryOption unions or Select value typing).
The Tasks page, Add Task modal, and Edit Task modal load without runtime errors and show the updated category options.

constraints: Keep all existing task categories exactly as they are; only add "LDC" and "Food Service".
Keep everything else in the Tasks module unchanged aside from what is necessary to add the two new category options and fix the build.
nonGoals: Do not add new backend storage fields or change the backend schema for tasks.
Do not change task status filtering behavior (All/Completed/Uncompleted buttons).
Do not change CSV export columns or formatting.
